title: SPAGBias: Uncovering and Tracing Structured Spatial Gender Bias in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using a three-layer framework (SPAGBias) across 62 urban micro-spaces: measuring explicit bias via repeated sampling of forced-choice prompts, probability bias via log-probability analysis of gender tokens, and construction bias via analyzing lexical choices, semantic roles, and narrative interactional roles in model-generated stories.
